data.one_liner: Official localized strings for Stream Chat Flutter widgets
data.what_it_does: Provides localized strings and localizations delegates for Stream Chat Flutter widgets across multiple supported languages. Handles system locale detection or programmatic setting of language preferences.
use_when: You are building a chat application using Stream Chat Flutter and need multi-language support
You want built-in translations for Stream Chat UI components in languages like English, Spanish, French, German, and others
avoid_when: You are not using Stream Chat Flutter in your application
You only need standard Flutter material localizations and do not use Stream widgets
strengths: Official localization package maintained by the Stream team
Supports a wide array of built-in languages with native implementations
Easily extensible to add new languages or override existing ones
weaknesses: Only provides localizations for Stream Chat widgets, not general app-wide localization
Some niche or secondary commands/languages may fall back to English if untranslated
data.setup_notes: Add supportedLocales and GlobalStreamChatLocalizations.delegates to your MaterialApp, and add supported localizations to iOS Info.plist if targeting iOS.
data.minimal_example:
MaterialApp(
  supportedLocales: const [
    Locale('en'),
    Locale('es'),
  ],
  localizationsDelegates: GlobalStreamChatLocalizations.delegates,
  home: StreamChannel(
    channel: channel,
    child: const ChannelPage(),
  ),
)
